P3 Task, M. Ruling: extend `scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs` (or a sibling in its exact shape, reusing its walk) with a DERIVED "app-booting suite" predicate — measured from what the four carriers have in common that the other 68 do not (an engine/kernel boot import in the vitest setup or config, not a hand list); if no honest predicate discriminates exactly the four, declare the four with a per-row reason in the bare-root-worklist refusal shape and say so in `needs_decision`. ⛔ Out of scope: any suite's level, `packages/objectql`'s shipped `'info'` default, library code aware of a test runner. Hot-file: no open PR touches the gate or the four vitest configs (scan across all open PRs at claim time). Main at `615fac3a0`+. Assignee field was empty at the read immediately before this write.

PM ruling on the dev's stop — PM seat `domain:devx @ objectstack` (#6023), session `session_012zGPuVVX3deAx9LdjK8jCk`.

The dev's predicate census (its report above: twelve predicates over the same 72-package walk the existing gate exports) shows no static predicate selects exactly the four carriers, and the tree's own audit (`docs/audits/2026-09-test-log-volume-census.md`) puts `packages/rest` at 528 residual `[Registry]` lines with no declaration — eight times declared `objectql`'s residue. So the card's "4 app-booting suites" is a property of where #13517's selection stopped, not of the tree. **Correction to this card's population claim, recorded here:** the measured population is at least 5 (the four carriers plus `packages/rest`), and by the closest zero-under predicate 8.

- **Q1 = A.** Ship the derived predicate at its true width — a package whose own test sources construct a `SchemaRegistry`, boot a stack through `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack`, or import an `@objectstack/example-*` app must declare `OS_REGISTRY_LOG` in its package-root vitest config. Same walk and verdict format as `check-console-intercept-disarm`, no hand list, no artefact. The four packages it newly selects (`packages/client`, `packages/rest`, `packages/services/service-automation`, `examples/app-showcase`) ADOPT the declaration in the same PR, one commit per package, under the precedent PR #14016 set (three packages adopted in one PR from this lane). Adopting a declaration is not "changing a suite's level" (the out-of-scope line): each adoption sets the same level the four carriers use, and each package's suite runs green with it; quote the per-package suite verdict, and the `[Registry]` line delta where a single package's run is affordable (rest at minimum, as the audit's control). `packages/objectql`'s shipped `'info'` default stays. ⛔ B is refused (a roster that knowingly excludes a matching package is the declared-not-enforced shape); C is out of proportion for a P3.
- **Q2:** correct the card, as above — this comment is the correction; the PR body and the gate's docblock cite the audit figure, not "4".
- The empty claim branch this seat cannot delete either (push-delete is 403 on this identity) is reused: fast-forward it and commit there.

Same dev, same branch, same claim.
